Call Me Anna continues to explore her unique take on contemporary folk song. At once ancient yet modern, her voice captivates audiences.  Her debut EP Fall Of A Leaf EP was featured on the Radio 2 Folk Show and in Feb 2025 Call Me Anna was named a “highly recommended artist” after being selected to perform at Celtic Connections in Glasgow on the Danny Kyle Open Stage. She's becoming a popular live performer and her set has been described as “intimate and heartwarming” (Fatea)

Join Vince Cayo in celebrating the work of Shane MacGowan over two sets at Bingley's intimate Chip'N'Ern pub. 

This is not a tribute night - these will be one-off unique interpretation of known and lesser-known material done in Vince's own style and delivery whilst also paying his respects to one of his greatest influences, the recently departed Shane MacGowan.

One night only! Only 25 tickets available so secure them early and don't miss out on a truly one-off event.
